<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Related Party Transactions</a></td>
<td class="text"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">7.      Related Party Transactions</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Partnership Agreement</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The General Partner will control the business and affairs of the Fund, with oversight of certain matters by the Board of Directors. While the General Partner is responsible for the day to day business management of the Fund, various rights and obligations of the General Partner will be delegated to and performed by the Adviser. The responsibilities of the General Partner are set out in the Partnership Agreement.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Performance Allocation</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The General Partner or an affiliate will be entitled to a performance allocation (the &#8220;Performance Allocation&#8221;) in respect of each class of Units with the exception of Class E Units, an amount equal to </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">12.50</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% of the Fund&#8217;s total return for such class of Units, subject to a </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">5</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% annual hurdle amount and a high-water mark with a </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">100</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% catch-up, without duplication for any Performance Allocation paid by the Fund in respect of such class during such fiscal year.</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Fund recorded performance allocation of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">386,791</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">. For the comparative period of the three months ended June 30, 2025, the Fund did not incur any performance allocations. As of June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026, performance allocations of </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">$</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">693,475</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">$</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">306,684</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, respectively, were accrued and payable to the General Partner or an affiliate.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Advisory Agreement</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The management of the Fund is generally under the direction of the Adviser, at the delegation of the General Partner pursuant to the investment advisory agreement. Additionally, the Adviser has been delegated the ability to engage sub-advisers.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Management Fee</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">In consideration of the advisory services provided to the Fund by the Adviser, the Fund will pay the Adviser a management fee (the &#8220;Management Fee&#8221;), computed and payable monthly in arrears, at the annual rate of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">0.85</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% for the first 24 months from the Fund&#8217;s Initial Closing, and </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1.25</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% thereafter of the Fund&#8217;s NAV for Class S Units, Class D Units and Class I Units. Class E Units are not subject to the Management Fee, making it a class-specific expense</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Fund recorded management fees of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">216,600</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, of which the Adviser waived $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">69,312</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">. No management fees were recorded during the three months ended June 30, 2025.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Expense Limitation and Reimbursement Agreement</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Pursuant to the Expense Limitation and Reimbursement Agreement (the &#8220;Expense Limitation and Reimbursement Agreement&#8221;), for a five-year term beginning on the Initial Closing and ending on the five-year anniversary thereof, the Adviser has agreed to forgo an amount of its monthly Management Fee and/or pay, absorb or reimburse certain expenses of the Fund to the extent necessary so that, for each year during such five-year period beginning on the Initial Closing date or any anniversary thereof, the Fund&#8217;s annual Specified Expenses (as defined below) do not exceed </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">0.70</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%, on an annualized basis, of the sum of (a) the Fund&#8217;s net asset value as of the last calendar day of each calendar month or as otherwise determined by the Adviser and (b) to the extent deducted in the determination of the Fund&#8217;s net asset value as set forth in clause (a), accrued expenses, any accrued/allocated Management Fee, or Performance Allocation or distribution and/or servicing fee applicable to certain classes. The Fund has agreed to reimburse the amount of any forgone Management Fee and expenses paid, absorbed or reimbursed by the Adviser, when and if requested by the Adviser, within five years from the end of the month in which the Adviser waived, paid, absorbed or reimbursed such fees or expenses, but only if and to the extent that Specified Expenses, on an annualized basis, plus any recoupment, do not exceed </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">0.70</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% of the sum of (a) the Fund&#8217;s net asset value as of the last calendar day of each calendar month or as otherwise determined by the Adviser and (b) to the extent deducted in the determination of the Fund&#8217;s net asset value as set forth in clause (a), accrued expenses, any accrued/allocated Management Fee, or Performance Allocation or distribution and/or servicing fee applicable to certain classes (or, if a lower expense limit under the Expense Limitation and Reimbursement Agreement is then in effect, such lower limit). The Adviser may recapture a Specified Expense in the same year it is incurred. This arrangement cannot be terminated within the one-year period beginning on the Initial Closing without the Board of Directors&#8217; consent.</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Adviser may, in its sole discretion, advance the organizational and offering expenses attributable to the Fund through the first anniversary of the Initial Closing. The Fund will be obligated to reimburse the Adviser for all such advanced organizational and offering expenses over the five years following the first anniversary of the Initial Closing. The Adviser will determine what organizational and offering expenses are attributable to the Fund, in its sole discretion. As of June 30, 2026 and March 31, 2026, the organizational and offering expenses due to the Adviser from the Fund amounted to $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">3,827,484</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> and $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">3,800,000</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, respectively.</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#8220;Specified Expenses&#8221; means all expenses incurred in the business of the Fund, including, among other things, organizational and offering expenses, professional fees, and fees and expenses of the Fund&#8217;s administrator, custodian and transfer agent, with the exception of (i) the Management Fee; (ii) the Performance Allocation; (iii) any distribution and/or servicing fee paid applicable to any Units, including the distribution and/or servicing fee; (iv) transaction-related costs, including, without limitation, costs related to unconsummated transactions and hedging and other derivatives transactions; (v) interest payments; (vi) fees and expenses incurred in connection with a credit facility, if any, obtained by the Fund; (vii) taxes; (viii) portfolio company expenses, Intermediate Entity expenses and ordinary corporate operating expenses; and (ix) extraordinary expenses (as determined in the sole discretion of the Adviser).</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Foreign Currency Hedging Agreement</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Adviser entered into a foreign currency hedging agreement (&#8220;FX Hedging Agreement&#8221;) with Macquarie Investment Management Global Limited (the &#8220;FX Service Provider&#8221;), an affiliate, pursuant to which the FX Service Provider is appointed to act as agent of the Fund to implement foreign currency hedging strategies.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Under the FX Hedging Agreement, the FX Service Provider enters into foreign exchange transactions, including spot and forward contracts, to hedge the Fund&#8217;s exposure to non-U.S. dollar denominated investments, in accordance with specified hedging instructions and target hedge ratios. The FX Service Provider is authorized to execute derivative transactions and related  documentation with approved counterparties on behalf of the Fund.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">  </span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The FX Service Provider is entitled to a fee calculated at an annual rate of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">0.03</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% of the hedged notional exposure, subject to a minimum annual fee of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">50,000</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">, with such fees accrued monthly and invoiced quarterly. The Fund is also responsible for transaction-related costs incurred in connection with FX hedging activities. For the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Fund recognized $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">12,500</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of such fees.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Distribution and/or Servicing Fees</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Macquarie Capital (USA) Inc., an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Macquarie Group Limited and therefore a related party of the Fund, serves as placement agent (the &#8220;Placement Agent&#8221;). T</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">he Fund pays the Placement Agent a monthly fee out of the net assets of Class S Units and Class D Units at the annual rate of </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">0.85</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% and </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">0.25</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% of the NAV of Class S Units and Class D Units, respectively, determined and accrued as of the last day of each calendar month (before any redemptions of Class S Units or Class D Units) (the &#8220;</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Distribution and/or Servicing Fee</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#8221;). The Adviser remits payment of the ongoing Distribution and/or Servicing Fees on behalf of the Fund and is reimbursed by the Fund for such payments. The Distribution and/or Servicing Fee is charged on an aggregate class-wide basis, and Investors in Class S Units or Class D Units are subject to the Distribution and/or Servicing Fee as long as they hold their Class S Units or Class D Units, respectively.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">MGECO Equity Commitment fee</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">As of June 30, 2026, the Fund had a payable of $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">170,598</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> to MGECO relating to the Letter of Credit with Aula Energy (&#8220;Letter of Credit&#8221;). This Letter of Credit issued under the MGECO Bridge Facility provides credit support on behalf of both MGECO and the Fund and the Fund reimburses MGECO on a quarterly basis for its proportionate share of the MGECO Bridge arrangement fee and LC fee, a 50 basis points per annum risk premium to compensate MGECO for the security it will provide on behalf of the Fund and its pro rata share of the MGECO Bridge Facility legal budget.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Purchases with related entities</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">During the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Fund made an additional investment in affiliated funds amounting to $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">47,737,091</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Proceeds from Units Issued</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">During the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Fund sold Class E Units to affiliates of the General Partner for aggregate  consideration of </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">$</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">41,000,000</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">. The offer and sale of the Class E Units were made as part of the Fund&#8217;s continuous private offering and were exempt from the registration provisions of the Securities Act, pursuant to Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D thereunder.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Feeder</span></p><p style="text-indent:4.533%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">METI TE Feeder, L.P. is a feeder vehicle for the Fund. The Feeder was established to allow certain Investors with particular tax characteristics, such as tax-exempt Investors and non-U.S. Investors, to participate in the Fund in a more efficient manner. Investors in the Feeder will indirectly bear their pro rata portion of the management fee and performance participation allocation paid by the Fund, but such expenses will not be duplicated at the Feeder level.</span></p><span></span>
</td>
</tr>

<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_RelatedPartyTransactionsDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Related Party Transactions</a></td>
<td class="text"><div class="item-list-element-wrapper" style="tab-size:32px;display:flex;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;justify-content:flex-start;font-family:Times New Roman;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:0;min-width:4.537%;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:4.537%;word-break:keep-all;display:inline-flex;justify-content:flex-start;">6.</span><div style="display:inline;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Related Party Transactions </span></div></div><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Aggregator Partnership Agreement</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The General Partner has exclusive authority to manage and control the business and affairs of the Aggregator, including responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the Aggregator. The responsibilities of the General Partner are set out in the Aggregator Partnership Agreement.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Acquisition of Investments from Affiliates</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Macquarie, MAM-Managed Entities and their affiliates may hold or acquire assets and contribute or sell such assets to the Fund, the Aggregator or their subsidiaries. These transfers may occur in kind, at fair market value (&#8220;FMV&#8221;) if transferred from a MAM-Managed Entity, or otherwise at cost plus roll forward or FMV, in each case as determined by the Adviser, plus related expenses, including transaction costs and a risk or similar premium.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">During the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Aggregator did not acquire any investments from affiliates of the Adviser.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:18pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Distributions</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:6pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Pursuant to the Aggregator Partnership Agreement, distributions of cash or other assets are made at the discretion of the General Partner. Distributions generally consist of available cash and are expected to occur at least monthly; however in certain circumstances, the General Partner may elect not to make distributions, including to retain cash for partnership expenses or reserves.</span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Distributions from each underlying investment are generally made to limited partners which include MAM-Managed Entities and their affiliates, on a pro rata basis.</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </span></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">For the three months ended June 30, 2026, the Aggregator distributed $</span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">7,589,236</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> to</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> MAM-Managed Entities and their affiliates.</span></p><span></span>
</td>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>The entire disclosure for related party transactions.
